## Purpose

Classifies each retained population by landscape history:

| Variable | Timescale | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `Tectonic` (Active / Stable) | deep time | WSA9 aggregated ecoregion |
| `Ice` (Glaciated / Unglaciated) | Last Glacial Maximum (~18 ka) | `ice18k` ice-sheet extent |
| `SeaLevel` (Flooded / Unflooded) | Pleistocene–Holocene sea level | Coastal Plains ecoregion south of 40.8° N |
| `Topography` (Highland / Lowland) | current | mean catchment elevation from script 04 |

These combine into the `History` category. The output is keyed by `Pop_id`.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)               # planar work in EPSG:5070
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: paths
path_pops      <- here("Data", "interim", "GenDiv_merged.csv")
path_lookup    <- here("Data", "interim", "comid_lookup.csv")
path_landscape <- here("Data", "interim", "landscape_nhd.csv")
path_ice       <- here("Data", "external", "hist_shp", "ice", "ice18k.shp")
path_ecor      <- here("Data", "external", "hist_shp", "Aggr_Ecoregions_2015",
                       "Aggr_Ecoregions_2015.shp")
path_out       <- here("Data", "interim", "landscape_hist.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: parameters
crs_work              <- 5070
active_ecoregions     <- c("WMT", "XER")   # Western Mountains, Xeric
flooded_ecoregion     <- "CPL"             # Coastal Plains
flooded_max_lat       <- 40.8              # northern limit of the flooded coastal plain
highland_threshold_m  <- 250
max_ecoregion_dist_m  <- 5000              # nearest-ecoregion fallback for points just outside

history_levels <- c(
  "Stable Unglaciated Lowland",
  "Stable Unglaciated Highland",
  "Stable Unglaciated Lowland - Flooded",
  "Stable Glaciated Lowland",
  "Stable Glaciated Highland",
  "Active Unglaciated Lowland",
  "Active Unglaciated Highland",
  "Active Glaciated Highland"
)
```

## Sites

```{r}
#| label: read-sites
lookup <- read_csv(path_lookup, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(retained) |>
  select(Pop_id, comid)

coords <- read_csv(path_pops, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(Pop_id, Latitude, Longitude)

elev <- read_csv(path_landscape, col_select = c(comid, lc_meanelev_m),
                 show_col_types = FALSE)

sites <- lookup |>
  left_join(coords, by = "Pop_id") |>
  left_join(elev, by = "comid")

stopifnot(
  "Pop_id duplicated"   = !anyDuplicated(sites$Pop_id),
  "Missing coordinates" = !anyNA(sites$Latitude)
)

sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326,
                     remove = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(crs_work)
```

**`r fmt(nrow(sites))`** retained populations;
`r fmt(sum(is.na(sites$lc_meanelev_m)))` have no catchment elevation.

## Glaciation

```{r}
#| label: ice
ice <- st_read(path_ice, quiet = TRUE) |>
  filter(SYMB == "ICE") |>
  st_transform(crs_work) |>
  st_make_valid()

# Any overlap with an ice polygon; avoids duplicate rows where polygons overlap
sites$glaciated <- lengths(st_intersects(sites_sf, ice)) > 0
```

**`r fmt(sum(sites$glaciated))`** populations
(`r round(100 * mean(sites$glaciated), 1)`%) are within the ~18 ka ice extent.

## Ecoregion

```{r}
#| label: ecoregion
ecor <- st_read(path_ecor, quiet = TRUE) |>
  select(WSA9) |>
  st_transform(crs_work) |>
  st_make_valid()

hits <- st_intersects(sites_sf, ecor)
sites$WSA9 <- vapply(hits, \(i) if (length(i)) ecor$WSA9[i[1]] else NA_character_,
                     character(1))
sites$ecoregion_match <- if_else(is.na(sites$WSA9), NA_character_, "within")
sites$ecoregion_dist_m <- 0

# Points just outside every polygon (shorelines, generalised boundaries):
# take the nearest ecoregion if it's close enough
miss <- which(is.na(sites$WSA9))
if (length(miss)) {
  i_near <- st_nearest_feature(sites_sf[miss, ], ecor)
  d_near <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites_sf[miss, ], ecor[i_near, ],
                                   by_element = TRUE))
  close  <- d_near <= max_ecoregion_dist_m
  sites$WSA9[miss[close]]            <- ecor$WSA9[i_near[close]]
  sites$ecoregion_match[miss[close]] <- "nearest"
  sites$ecoregion_dist_m[miss]       <- d_near
}
```

`r fmt(sum(sites$ecoregion_match == "within", na.rm = TRUE))` populations fall
inside an ecoregion polygon. `r fmt(length(miss))` do not;
`r fmt(sum(sites$ecoregion_match == "nearest", na.rm = TRUE))` of those were
assigned the nearest ecoregion (within `r fmt(max_ecoregion_dist_m)` m), and
**`r fmt(sum(is.na(sites$WSA9)))`** remain unassigned.

```{r}
#| label: ecoregion-table
count(sites, WSA9, name = "populations") |>
  kable()
```

## Classification

Missing inputs give `NA`, rather than defaulting to "Stable" or "Unflooded"
as in the original pipeline.

```{r}
#| label: classify
hist_dat <- sites |>
  mutate(
    Ice = if_else(glaciated, "Glaciated", "Unglaciated"),
    Tectonic = case_when(
      is.na(WSA9)                    ~ NA_character_,
      WSA9 %in% active_ecoregions    ~ "Active",
      TRUE                           ~ "Stable"
    ),
    SeaLevel = case_when(
      is.na(WSA9)                                           ~ NA_character_,
      WSA9 == flooded_ecoregion & Latitude < flooded_max_lat ~ "Flooded",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unflooded"
    ),
    Topography = case_when(
      is.na(lc_meanelev_m)                  ~ NA_character_,
      lc_meanelev_m > highland_threshold_m  ~ "Highland",
      TRUE                                  ~ "Lowland"
    ),
    History = if_else(
      is.na(Tectonic) | is.na(Topography),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(Tectonic, " ", Ice, " ", Topography,
             if_else(SeaLevel == "Flooded", " - Flooded", ""))
    )
  )

unexpected <- setdiff(na.omit(unique(hist_dat$History)), history_levels)
if (length(unexpected)) {
  warning("History combinations not in history_levels: ",
          paste(unexpected, collapse = "; "))
}

hist_dat$History <- factor(hist_dat$History,
                           levels = c(history_levels, sort(unexpected)))
```

```{r}
#| label: history-table
hist_dat |>
  count(History, name = "populations", .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(share = paste0(round(100 * populations / nrow(hist_dat), 1), "%")) |>
  kable()
```

**`r fmt(sum(hist_dat$Topography == "Highland", na.rm = TRUE))`** populations
are Highland and **`r fmt(sum(hist_dat$Topography == "Lowland", na.rm = TRUE))`**
Lowland at the `r highland_threshold_m` m threshold.
`r fmt(sum(is.na(hist_dat$History)))` have no `History` because of a missing
ecoregion or elevation.

## Map

```{r}
#| label: map
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5
states <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2023, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("HI", "PR", "AK", "MP", "GU", "AS", "VI")) |>
  st_transform(crs_work)

map_dat <- left_join(select(sites_sf, Pop_id),
                     select(hist_dat, Pop_id, History), by = "Pop_id")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = st_crop(ice, st_bbox(states)), fill = "#DCEBF5", colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_sf(data = map_dat, aes(colour = History), size = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey30") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```

## Write output

```{r}
#| label: write-output
hist_dat |>
  select(Pop_id, WSA9, ecoregion_match, ecoregion_dist_m,
         Ice, Tectonic, SeaLevel, Topography, History) |>
  write_csv(path_out)
```

Wrote **`r fmt(nrow(hist_dat))`** rows to `r basename(path_out)`. CSV doesn't
store factor order, so the final assembly script should re-apply
`history_levels`.
